comment: The pinned procgen scenario, run twice by design (cross-host determinism): og-core's procgen::tests::every_generator_gives_its_pinned_output_for_a_seed and packages/engine/tests/core.test.ts (through support/core-round.ts's --case procgen). Both read this file; a change here is a change to every seeded world. `pinned` holds the hashes both hosts must give. The weighted and permutation picks are a host's own stream (Rng::new here, og.Rng's fork "picks" of a world seeded 42 there), so their hashes are pinned in each test, not here.
